facts.name: Covered Avocation Definition
facts.sentence: The term 'Covered Avocation' refers to any one of the four avocations declared and endorsed in the Avocation Endorsement Schedule of this policy.

facts.name: Undeclared Hazardous Activity Definition
facts.sentence: The term 'Undeclared Hazardous Activity' refers to any extreme or hazardous activity not listed in the Avocation Endorsement Schedule.

facts.name: Escalation Event Definition
facts.sentence: An 'Escalation Event' is defined as a material increase in the risk profile of a Covered Avocation.

facts.name: Skydiving to Wingsuit Escalation
facts.sentence: Examples of an Escalation Event include increasing skydiving to wingsuit proximity flying.

facts.name: SCUBA to Cave Diving Escalation
facts.sentence: Examples of an Escalation Event include progressing SCUBA to cave diving.

facts.name: Mountaineering Risk Escalation
facts.sentence: Examples of an Escalation Event include ascending above 18,000 feet in mountaineering.

facts.name: Incident Report Definition
facts.sentence: An 'Incident Report' is defined as a written summary of any accident, near-miss, or injury occurring during a Covered Avocation.

facts.name: Incident Report Submission Deadline
facts.sentence: An Incident Report must be submitted to the company within 60 days.

facts.name: Death Benefit Coverage
facts.sentence: The policy provides a death benefit of $1,000,000 upon the insured's death during the policy period.

facts.name: Death Benefit Coverage
facts.sentence: The death benefit applies regardless of cause, including Covered Avocations.

facts.name: Timely Death Benefit Payout
facts.sentence: Payment of the death benefit occurs within 30 days of satisfactory proof of death.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Clause
facts.sentence: There is an exclusion for suicide: death by suicide within 2 years of the policy date limits the benefit to return of premiums paid.

facts.name: Exclusion for Undeclared Hazards
facts.sentence: There is an exclusion for Undeclared Hazardous Activities: death or injury arising from any Undeclared Hazardous Activity is excluded.

facts.name: Excluded Hazardous Activities
facts.sentence: Base jumping is an example of an excluded activity under the Undeclared Hazardous Activities exclusion.

facts.name: Excluded Hazard Example
facts.sentence: Wingsuit proximity flying is an example of an excluded activity under the Undeclared Hazardous Activities exclusion.

facts.name: Excluded High-Altitude Mountaineering
facts.sentence: Solo high-altitude mountaineering above 18,000 feet is an example of an excluded activity under the Undeclared Hazardous Activities exclusion.

facts.name: Excluded Hazardous Activity Example
facts.sentence: Cave or wreck penetration SCUBA is an example of an excluded activity under the Undeclared Hazardous Activities exclusion.

facts.name: Excluded Free Solo Activity
facts.sentence: Free solo is an example of an excluded activity under the Undeclared Hazardous Activities exclusion.

facts.name: Non-Exhaustive Exclusions
facts.sentence: The list of excluded activities is non-exhaustive.

facts.name: Base Jumping Exclusion
facts.sentence: Base jumping is an excluded activity.

facts.name: Wingsuit Proximity Flying Exclusion
facts.sentence: Wingsuit proximity flying is an excluded activity.

facts.name: Solo High-Altitude Mountaineering Exclusion
facts.sentence: Solo high-altitude mountaineering above 18,000 feet is an excluded activity.

facts.name: Cave Wreck Penetration Exclusion
facts.sentence: Cave or wreck penetration SCUBA is an excluded activity.

facts.name: Free Solo Climbing Exclusion
facts.sentence: Free solo climbing is an excluded activity.

facts.name: Excluded: Whitewater Class V+ Kayaking
facts.sentence: Whitewater class V+ kayaking is an excluded activity.

facts.name: Motorsport Racing Exclusion
facts.sentence: Motorsport racing is an excluded activity.

facts.name: New Hazard Approval Requirement
facts.sentence: Adding a new hazardous activity requires prior underwriting approval.

facts.name: New Hazard Surcharge
facts.sentence: Adding a new hazardous activity may result in an additional surcharge.

facts.name: Undisclosed Escalation Event Consequence
facts.sentence: If the insured engages in an Escalation Event without notifying the company, the claim will be treated as arising from an Undeclared Hazardous Activity.

facts.name: Unauthorized Escalation Event Claim Denial
facts.sentence: If the insured engages in an Escalation Event without obtaining written approval, the claim will be treated as arising from an Undeclared Hazardous Activity.

facts.name: Claim Denial for Unapproved Escalation Events
facts.sentence: Any claim arising from an Escalation Event without notification and written approval will be denied or adjusted accordingly.

facts.name: Intoxication Exclusion
facts.sentence: No benefit is provided for death occurring while the insured is impaired by alcohol during any Covered Avocation.

facts.name: Intoxication Exclusion During Avocations
facts.sentence: No benefit is provided for injury occurring while the insured is impaired by unprescribed controlled substances during any Covered Avocation.

facts.name: Claim Documentation Requirement
facts.sentence: For claims involving a Covered Avocation, the beneficiary must provide a certified death certificate.

facts.name: Claim Documentation Requirement
facts.sentence: For claims involving a Covered Avocation, the beneficiary must provide an incident report if available.

facts.name: Witness Requirement for Claims
facts.sentence: For claims involving a Covered Avocation, the beneficiary must provide names of at least one witness or guide, if applicable.

facts.name: Skydiving Claim Documentation
facts.sentence: For claims involving a Covered Avocation, the beneficiary must provide equipment logs or jump logs for skydiving claims.

facts.name: Documentation Delay Consequence
facts.sentence: Failure to provide avocation documentation may delay claim processing.

facts.name: Claim Documentation Exception
facts.sentence: Failure to provide avocation documentation will not by itself result in denial if the cause of death is otherwise confirmed.

facts.name: Base Premium Amount
facts.sentence: The base annual premium is $1,140.00.

facts.name: Total Premium Including Riders
facts.sentence: The total annual premium including riders is $1,420.00.

facts.name: Return of Premium Inclusion
facts.sentence: The Return of Premium feature is included in the base policy and is not a separate rider.

facts.name: Return of Base Premium on Survival
facts.sentence: If the insured survives until the policy expiration date (March 3, 2044), 100% of all base premiums paid will be refunded.

facts.name: Tax-Free Refund Feature
facts.sentence: The refund under the Return of Premium feature is tax-free.

facts.name: Return of Premium Excludes Riders
facts.sentence: The refund under the Return of Premium feature does not deduct rider premiums.

facts.name: Return of Premium Excludes Late Charges
facts.sentence: The refund under the Return of Premium feature does not deduct late charges.

facts.name: Refund Excludes Loan Deductions
facts.sentence: The refund under the Return of Premium feature does not deduct loans.

facts.name: No Refund in Early Lapse/Surrender
facts.sentence: If the policy lapses or is surrendered during years 1–5, there is a 0% return of base premiums.

facts.name: Partial Return: Years 6–10
facts.sentence: If the policy lapses or is surrendered during years 6–10, 30% of base premiums paid will be returned.

facts.name: Partial Refund: Years 11–15
facts.sentence: If the policy lapses or is surrendered during years 11–15, 60% of base premiums paid will be returned.

facts.name: Partial Return: Years 16–19
facts.sentence: If the policy lapses or is surrendered during years 16–19, 80% of base premiums paid will be returned.

facts.name: Full Term Return Eligibility
facts.sentence: If the policy lapses or is surrendered at year 20 (full term), 100% of base premiums paid will be returned.

facts.sentence: Rohan Krishnamurthy receives 100% of the death benefit.

facts.sentence: The contingent beneficiaries are Arjun Krishnamurthy and Meera Krishnamurthy.

facts.name: Daughter Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: Meera Krishnamurthy is designated as the daughter of the insured.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Share
facts.sentence: Arjun Krishnamurthy receives 50% of the death benefit as a contingent beneficiary.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Share
facts.sentence: Meera Krishnamurthy receives 50% of the death benefit as a contingent beneficiary.

facts.name: Definition of Total Disability
facts.sentence: Total Disability means complete inability, due to injury or sickness, to engage in any gainful occupation for which the insured is reasonably suited by education, training, or experience.

facts.name: Heart Attack Covered Under Critical Illness
facts.sentence: Critical Illness includes heart attack when diagnosed after the policy date.

facts.name: Critical Illness Coverage
facts.sentence: Critical Illness includes stroke when diagnosed after the policy date.

facts.name: Critical Illness Inclusion
facts.sentence: Critical Illness includes invasive cancer when diagnosed after the policy date.

facts.name: Critical Illness Coverage
facts.sentence: Critical Illness includes kidney failure when diagnosed after the policy date.

facts.name: Critical Illness Coverage
facts.sentence: Critical Illness includes major organ transplant when diagnosed after the policy date.

facts.name: Critical Illness Coverage
facts.sentence: Critical Illness includes coronary artery bypass surgery when diagnosed after the policy date.

facts.name: Definition of Critical Illness
facts.sentence: The term 'Critical Illness' means any of the following conditions first diagnosed after the policy date: heart attack, stroke, invasive cancer, kidney failure, major organ transplant, or coronary artery bypass surgery.

facts.name: Base Premium Definition
facts.sentence: The term 'Base Premium' means the annual premium attributable solely to the base policy face amount, excluding all rider premiums.

facts.name: Death Benefit Payout Condition
facts.sentence: We will pay the face amount upon the insured's death during the policy period, provided the policy is in force and all due premiums have been paid.

facts.name: Death Benefit Payout Timeline
facts.sentence: The death benefit is paid to the named beneficiary within 21 business days of receiving a completed claim with satisfactory proof of death.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Clause
facts.sentence: If death occurs by suicide, whether sane or insane, within 2 years of the policy date, the benefit is limited to premiums paid without interest.

facts.name: Policy Voidance on Misrepresentation
facts.sentence: If the application contains a material misrepresentation discovered within 2 years of the policy date, we may void the policy and refund premiums.

facts.name: Policy Incontestability Clause
facts.sentence: After 2 years from the policy date, the policy is incontestable except for non-payment of premiums.

facts.name: Critical Illness Accelerated Benefit
facts.sentence: Rider 1 is called the Critical Illness Accelerated Benefit Rider.

facts.name: Rider 1 Annual Premium
facts.sentence: The premium for Rider 1 is $155 per year.

facts.name: 50% Accelerated Benefit
facts.sentence: An advance of 50% of the face amount is payable upon first diagnosis of a covered Critical Illness under Rider 1.

facts.name: Maximum Advance Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum lump-sum advance under Rider 1 is $250,000.

facts.name: No Actuarial Discount on Advance
facts.sentence: No actuarial discount is applied to the advance paid under Rider 1.

facts.name: Preserved Death Benefit
facts.sentence: The remaining 50% of the death benefit is preserved for beneficiaries when a critical illness advance is paid.

facts.name: Accelerated Benefit Use Flexibility
facts.sentence: The accelerated benefit under Rider 1 may be used for any purpose.

facts.name: 50% Face Amount Advance
facts.sentence: The policy allows an advance of 50% of the face amount.

facts.name: Maximum Advance Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum advance amount is $250,000.

facts.name: No Actuarial Discount Applied
facts.sentence: No actuarial discount is applied to the advance.

facts.name: Death Benefit Preservation
facts.sentence: The remaining 50% of the death benefit is preserved for beneficiaries.

facts.name: Flexible Use of Advance Payment
facts.sentence: The advance may be used for any purpose, including medical or non-medical expenses.

facts.name: One-Time Advance Benefit
facts.sentence: The advance is a one-time benefit per policy.

facts.name: Rider Termination After Claim
facts.sentence: The rider terminates after a claim is made.

facts.name: 30-Day Waiting Period Eligibility
facts.sentence: There is a 30-day waiting period from the policy effective date before the benefit becomes eligible.

facts.name: Survival After Diagnosis Requirement
facts.sentence: The insured must survive at least 30 days after diagnosis to receive the benefit.

facts.name: Heart Attack Covered
facts.sentence: Covered critical illnesses include heart attack.

facts.name: Stroke Covered
facts.sentence: Covered critical illnesses include stroke.

facts.name: Invasive Cancer Coverage
facts.sentence: Covered critical illnesses include invasive cancer, excluding skin cancer in situ.

facts.name: End-Stage Renal Failure Coverage
facts.sentence: Covered critical illnesses include end-stage renal failure.

facts.name: Major Organ Transplant Coverage
facts.sentence: Covered critical illnesses include major organ transplant.

facts.name: Coronary Artery Bypass Surgery Coverage
facts.sentence: Covered critical illnesses include coronary artery bypass surgery.

facts.name: Blindness (Both Eyes, Permanent)

facts.sentence: The acknowledgment and consent by Marcus DeShawn Okafor comply with applicable state insurable interest requirements.

facts.name: Ownership Transfer on Dissolution
facts.sentence: If Vertex Dynamics LLC is dissolved, ownership of the policy transfers to the estate of Marcus DeShawn Okafor.

facts.name: Ownership Transfer on Acquisition
facts.sentence: If Vertex Dynamics LLC is acquired, ownership of the policy transfers to the estate of Marcus DeShawn Okafor.

facts.name: Ownership Transfer on Dissolution
facts.sentence: If Vertex Dynamics LLC ceases operations, ownership of the policy transfers to the estate of Marcus DeShawn Okafor.

facts.name: Estate Transfer Condition
facts.sentence: Ownership transfer to the estate of the insured only occurs if no successor owner is designated in writing before dissolution, acquisition, or cessation of operations.

facts.name: Face Amount: $2M
facts.sentence: The face amount of the base policy is $2,000,000.

facts.name: Policy Duration and Expiration
facts.sentence: The policy period lasts 15 years and expires on January 15, 2039.

facts.name: Base Annual Premium
facts.sentence: The base annual premium is $4,830.00.

facts.name: Total Annual Premium with Riders
facts.sentence: The total annual premium, including riders, is $5,610.00.

facts.name: Split-Dollar Arrangement
facts.sentence: This policy is subject to a collateral assignment split-dollar arrangement.

facts.name: Split-Dollar Arrangement Parties
facts.sentence: The split-dollar arrangement is between the owner and the insured.

facts.name: Split-Dollar Agreement Terms
facts.sentence: The terms of the split-dollar arrangement are specified in a separate Split-Dollar Agreement.

facts.name: Split-Dollar Agreement Date
facts.sentence: The Split-Dollar Agreement is dated January 15, 2024.

facts.name: Tax Treatment Disclaimer
facts.sentence: The insurance company takes no responsibility for the tax treatment of any split-dollar arrangement.

facts.name: Successor Owner Upon Dissolution
facts.sentence: A Successor Owner is defined in the case where Vertex Dynamics LLC is dissolved.

facts.name: Successor Owner on Acquisition
facts.sentence: A Successor Owner is defined in the case where Vertex Dynamics LLC is acquired.

facts.name: Successor Owner Transfer
facts.sentence: A Successor Owner is defined in the case where Vertex Dynamics LLC ceases operations.

facts.name: Estate Transfer on Dissolution
facts.sentence: Ownership transfers to the estate of the insured if Vertex Dynamics LLC is dissolved.

facts.name: Acquisition Transfer Clause
facts.sentence: Ownership transfers to the estate of the insured if Vertex Dynamics LLC is acquired.

facts.name: Owner Transfer on Cessation
facts.sentence: Ownership transfers to the estate of the insured if Vertex Dynamics LLC ceases operations.

facts.name: Successor Owner Designation
facts.sentence: A successor owner may be designated in writing before a dissolution, acquisition, or cessation of operations.

facts.name: Successor Owner Designation
facts.sentence: If a new owner is designated in writing before a dissolution, acquisition, or cessation of operations, that person becomes the successor owner.

facts.name: Key Person Loss Definition
facts.sentence: Key Person Loss means the death of the insured during the policy period.

facts.name: Key Person Loss Impact
facts.sentence: Key Person Loss results in financial loss to the business owner.

facts.name: Disability Definition
facts.sentence: Disability means total and permanent inability of the insured to perform the material duties of their regular occupation.

facts.name: Physician Certification Requirement
facts.sentence: Disability must be certified by a physician acceptable to the insurer.

facts.name: Disability Duration Requirement
facts.sentence: Disability must last at least 12 consecutive months.

facts.name: Business Continuation Event Definition
facts.sentence: Business Continuation Event means the death of the insured from active participation in the business.

facts.name: Disability as Business Continuation Event
facts.sentence: Business Continuation Event means the disability of the insured from active participation in the business.

facts.name: Departure Definition
facts.sentence: Business Continuation Event means the departure of the insured from active participation in the business.

facts.name: Death Benefit Payout
facts.sentence: The insurer will pay a $2,000,000 death benefit to Vertex Dynamics LLC.

facts.name: Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: Vertex Dynamics LLC is the beneficiary of the death benefit under this policy.

facts.name: Death Benefit Payout Condition
facts.sentence: Payment of the death benefit occurs upon the death of the insured.

facts.name: Policy In Force Condition
facts.sentence: The policy must be in force at the time of the insured’s death for the death benefit to be payable.

facts.name: Premiums Required for Payout
facts.sentence: All premiums must have been paid for the death benefit to be payable.

facts.name: Death Benefit Payout Timeline
facts.sentence: The death benefit will be paid within 15 business days of receiving a completed claim.

facts.name: Death Certificate Requirement
facts.sentence: A certified death certificate must be submitted to initiate payment of the death benefit.

facts.name: Owner Authorization Requirement
facts.sentence: Written authorization from the owner is required before the death benefit can be paid.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Trigger
facts.sentence: Death by suicide within two years of the policy date triggers the suicide exclusion.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Payout
facts.sentence: Under the suicide exclusion, only the return of premiums paid is provided.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Terms
facts.sentence: Interest is not applied to returned premiums under the suicide exclusion.

facts.name: Felony Death Exclusion
facts.sentence: No death benefit is payable if the insured’s death results from their own commission of a felony.

facts.name: Felony Proof Requirement
facts.sentence: The felony must be established by a final criminal judgment to trigger the fraud/criminal act exclusion.

facts.name: Civil Court Basis for Fraud Exclusion
facts.sentence: A civil court finding may also establish the basis for the fraud/criminal act exclusion.

facts.name: War Exclusion Clause
facts.sentence: No death benefit is payable if the insured’s death results from declared war.

facts.name: Undeclared War Exclusion
facts.sentence: No death benefit is payable if the insured’s death results from undeclared war.

facts.name: War Conflict Exclusion
facts.sentence: No death benefit is payable if the insured’s death results from armed conflict.

facts.name: War Exclusion: Combatant Participation
facts.sentence: Voluntary participation by the insured as a combatant in armed conflict triggers the war exclusion.

facts.name: Civilian War Zone Accident Coverage
facts.sentence: Accidental death occurring in a war zone while the insured is present in a civilian capacity is covered.

facts.name: Attached Business Rider
facts.sentence: The Business Overhead Expense Disability Rider is attached to this policy.

facts.name: Annual Premium for Rider
facts.sentence: The annual premium for the Business Overhead Expense Disability Rider is $520.

facts.name: Total Disability Trigger
facts.sentence: The rider applies if the insured becomes totally disabled.

facts.name: Total Disability Definition
facts.sentence: Total disability means the insured cannot perform their occupational duties.

facts.name: Total Disability Duration Requirement
facts.sentence: The total disability status must last for 60 or more consecutive days to qualify for benefits.

facts.name: Monthly Overhead Coverage Limit
facts.sentence: The rider pays up to $15,000 per month toward covered business overhead expenses.

facts.name: Payment Limitation Rule
facts.sentence: If the actual outstanding principal balance on the covered mortgage is less than the scheduled benefit amount for that year, the payment made will be limited to the scheduled benefit amount.

facts.name: Lesser Amount Payment Rule
facts.sentence: When the actual outstanding principal balance is less than the scheduled benefit amount, the lesser of the two amounts will be paid.

facts.name: Claim Documentation Requirement
facts.sentence: Documentation of a mortgage statement is required at the time of claim submission.

facts.name: Primary Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: First Federal Mortgage Bank is designated as the primary beneficiary under the policy.

facts.name: Bank Entitlement Limit

facts.name: Excess Benefit Rights

facts.name: Definition of Tobacco User
facts.sentence: A 'Tobacco User' is defined as any person who has used tobacco in any form within the 24 months preceding the policy application.

facts.name: Definition of Covered Mortgage
facts.sentence: A 'Covered Mortgage' refers to the first-lien mortgage on the property identified in the policy.

facts.name: Covered Mortgage Origin Timing
facts.sentence: The 'Covered Mortgage' was originated simultaneously with the issuance of this policy.

facts.name: Outstanding Balance Definition
facts.sentence: An 'Outstanding Balance' is defined as the principal balance remaining on the covered mortgage as of the date of the insured's death.

facts.name: Documenting Outstanding Balance
facts.sentence: The 'Outstanding Balance' must be documented by the servicer's payoff statement.

facts.name: Scheduled Benefit Payment Trigger
facts.sentence: Upon the death of either insured, the scheduled benefit for the policy year in which death occurs shall be paid.

facts.name: Beneficiary Payment Order
facts.sentence: Payment of the scheduled benefit is made to the named beneficiaries in the order specified.

facts.name: First-to-Die Payout Trigger
facts.sentence: The first-to-die event triggers the payout of the scheduled benefit.

facts.name: Death Benefit Payout Condition
facts.sentence: Upon the death of either insured person, the insurance company will pay the scheduled benefit for the policy year in which death occurs.

facts.name: Scheduled Benefit Payout
facts.sentence: The scheduled benefit is payable to the named beneficiaries.

facts.name: Beneficiary Payout Order
facts.sentence: Beneficiaries receive the scheduled benefit in the order designated in the policy.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Clause
facts.sentence: If either insured dies by suicide within two years of the policy date, the insurance company will pay only the total premiums paid without interest.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Clause
facts.sentence: Suicide within two years of the policy date triggers the exclusion under Section 1.2.

facts.name: Insured Person Identification
facts.sentence: Sandra Lee Whitmore is an insured person covered under the policy.

facts.name: Tobacco Misrepresentation Exclusion
facts.sentence: If Sandra Lee Whitmore understated her tobacco use on the application, and material misrepresentation is proven, coverage will be rescinded.

facts.name: Tobacco Misrep Within Contestability
facts.sentence: Material misrepresentation related to tobacco use must be established within the contestability period.

facts.name: Tobacco Misrep Rescission
facts.sentence: Rescission of coverage due to tobacco misrepresentation results in refund of premiums.

facts.name: BASE Jumping Claim Review
facts.sentence: Death caused by BASE jumping within twelve months before death requires claims review.

facts.name: Hazardous Activity Review Trigger
facts.sentence: Death caused by free solo climbing within twelve months before death requires claims review.

facts.name: Unlicensed Motor Race Review
facts.sentence: Participation in an unlicensed motor race within twelve months before death requires claims review.

facts.name: Hazardous Activity Claim Adjustment
facts.sentence: Claims involving hazardous activity may result in adjusted or denied payouts.

facts.name: Unemployment Premium Waiver Inclusion
facts.sentence: The Unemployment Premium Waiver Rider is included in the base premium.

facts.name: Unemployment Premium Waiver Eligibility
facts.sentence: Either insured person may qualify for premium waiver under the Unemployment Premium Waiver Rider.

facts.name: Unemployment Duration Requirement
facts.sentence: A qualifying involuntary unemployment event lasts six months or longer.

facts.name: Unemployment Premium Waiver Terms
facts.sentence: Premiums are waived for up to twelve months per unemployment event under the Unemployment Premium Waiver Rider.

facts.name: Maximum Two Waiver Events
facts.sentence: There is a maximum limit of two unemployment waiver events per policy over its life.

facts.name: Unemployment Proof Requirement
facts.sentence: Insured persons must provide documentation proving they received state unemployment benefits to activate the waiver.

facts.name: Unemployment Rider Exclusion
facts.sentence: The Unemployment Premium Waiver Rider does not apply to self-employed insured individuals.

facts.name: Unemployment Waiver Ineligibility
facts.sentence: Voluntary separation from employment does not trigger the Unemployment Premium Waiver Rider.

facts.name: Unemployment Rider Availability Window
facts.sentence: The Unemployment Premium Waiver Rider is available only during policy years 1 through 15.

facts.name: Mortgage Disability Income Premium
facts.sentence: The Mortgage Disability Income Rider has an annual premium cost of four hundred ten dollars ($410).

facts.name: Annual Premium for Mortgage Rider
facts.sentence: The additional premium for the Mortgage Disability Income Rider is charged annually.

facts.name: Total Disability Benefit Eligibility
facts.sentence: Either insured person may become eligible for the Mortgage Disability Income Rider benefit upon becoming totally disabled.

facts.name: Total Disability Definition
facts.sentence: Total disability means inability to perform substantial gainful work.

facts.name: Mortgage Payment Payout Timing
facts.sentence: After a sixty-day elimination period, the insurer begins paying the monthly mortgage payment amount directly to the mortgage servicer.

facts.name: Mortgage Payment Amount
facts.sentence: The monthly mortgage payment amount paid by the insurer is twenty-three hundred eighty dollars ($2,380).

facts.name: Disability Benefit Duration Limit
facts.sentence: Each disability event allows for a maximum benefit period of twenty-four months.

facts.name: Mortgage Payment Lifetime Cap
facts.sentence: The total lifetime cap for mortgage payments via the rider is thirty-six months.

facts.name: Single Disability Benefit Activation
facts.sentence: Only one insured’s disability benefit can be active at any given time under the Mortgage Disability Income Rider.

facts.name: Accelerated Terminal Illness Benefit
facts.sentence: The Accelerated Terminal Illness Benefit is offered as a rider attached to the policy.

facts.name: Disability Benefit Duration
facts.sentence: A single disability event allows up to 24 months of disability benefit.

facts.name: Lifetime Disability Benefit Cap
facts.sentence: The total lifetime maximum for disability benefits is capped at 36 months of mortgage payments.

facts.name: Single Disability Benefit Activation
facts.sentence: Only one insured person’s disability benefit can be active at any given time.

facts.name: No Additional Charge for Rider 3
facts.sentence: There is no additional cost for Rider 3: Accelerated Terminal Illness Benefit.

facts.name: Accelerated Terminal Illness Access
facts.sentence: An insured may access the accelerated terminal illness benefit if they are diagnosed with a terminal condition.

facts.name: Terminal Condition Eligibility
facts.sentence: A diagnosis of a terminal condition must come with a life expectancy of 12 months or less to qualify for the accelerated benefit.

facts.name: Accelerated Terminal Illness Benefit
facts.sentence: Up to 50% of the scheduled death benefit may be accelerated under the terminal illness provision.

facts.name: Minimum Acceleration Amount
facts.sentence: The minimum amount that may be paid through the accelerated terminal illness benefit is $25,000.

facts.name: Maximum Accelerated Payout
facts.sentence: The maximum amount that may be paid through the accelerated terminal illness benefit is $190,000.

facts.name: Accelerated Benefit Reduction
facts.sentence: Payments from the accelerated terminal illness benefit reduce the beneficiary death benefit dollar-for-dollar.

facts.name: Tobacco Abstinence Requirement
facts.sentence: Sandra Lee Whitmore may apply for Non-Tobacco reclassification after maintaining 12 consecutive months of tobacco abstinence.

facts.name: Non-Tobacco Reclassification Test Requirement
facts.sentence: Reclassification to Non-Tobacco status requires passing a cotinine urine test.

facts.name: Non-Tobacco Reclassification Test Requirement
facts.sentence: Reclassification to Non-Tobacco status requires passing a cotinine saliva test.

facts.name: Tobacco Cessation Statement Requirement
facts.sentence: Reclassification to Non-Tobacco status requires submission of a written statement confirming tobacco cessation.

facts.name: Non-Tobacco Rate Recalculation
facts.sentence: If Sandra Lee Whitmore is approved for Non-Tobacco reclassification, her premiums will be recalculated based on the Non-Tobacco rate.

facts.name: Premium Recalculation Based on Attained Age
facts.sentence: The recalculation of premiums occurs using Sandra Lee Whitmore’s attained age at the time of reclassification.

facts.name: Non-Retroactive Premium Adjustment
facts.sentence: No retroactive change to past premiums will occur upon approval of Non-Tobacco reclassification.

facts.name: Tobacco Resumption Disclosure Requirement
facts.sentence: If Sandra Lee Whitmore resumes tobacco use after reclassification, she must disclose this information during future applications.

facts.name: Non-Disclosure Penalty
facts.sentence: Failure to disclose resumed tobacco use at reclassification may result in a benefit reduction.

facts.name: Nondisclosure Penalty Cap
facts.sentence: Benefit reductions due to nondisclosure cannot exceed the premium difference between tobacco and non-tobacco rates.

facts.name: Penalty Based on Undisclosed Use Duration
facts.sentence: The penalty for nondisclosure applies over the number of years of undisclosed tobacco use.

facts.sentence: To reinstate the policy, all outstanding premiums must be paid.

facts.name: Estate Tax Exclusion Eligibility
facts.sentence: Proceeds from this policy may not be included in the insured’s gross estate for federal estate tax purposes.

facts.name: No Incidents of Ownership
facts.sentence: For the policy proceeds to exclude the insured’s gross estate, the insured must not retain any incidents of ownership.

facts.name: Trust Establishment Requirement
facts.sentence: For the policy proceeds to exclude the insured’s gross estate, the trust must have been properly established.

facts.name: No Tax Guarantee from Insurer
facts.sentence: The insurance company does not provide any guarantee or representation regarding the tax treatment of this policy.

facts.name: Consult Estate Planning Counsel
facts.sentence: Individuals should consult qualified estate planning counsel regarding the tax implications of this policy.

facts.name: Terminal Condition Definition
facts.sentence: A Terminal Condition is defined as a medical condition expected to result in death within 18 months.

facts.name: Terminal Condition Certification Requirement
facts.sentence: A Terminal Condition must be certified by two licensed physicians.

facts.name: Specialist Physician Requirement
facts.sentence: At least one of the two physicians certifying a Terminal Condition must be a specialist in the relevant medical field.

facts.name: Measurable Cognitive Decline
facts.sentence: Cognitive Impairment refers to a measurable deterioration or loss of intellectual capacity.

facts.name: Cognitive Impairment Diagnosis
facts.sentence: Clinical evidence can support a diagnosis of Cognitive Impairment.

facts.name: Standardized Testing for Cognitive Impairment
facts.sentence: Standardized testing can support a diagnosis of Cognitive Impairment.

facts.name: Cognitive Impairment Definition
facts.sentence: Cognitive Impairment necessitates substantial supervision to protect oneself or others.

facts.name: Definition of Substantial Activity
facts.sentence: Substantial Activity is defined as a functional limitation that requires assistance with three or more activities.

facts.name: Definition of Airement
facts.sentence: Airement means a deterioration or loss of intellectual capacity as measured by clinical evidence or standardized tests.

facts.name: Cognitive Decline Supervision Requirement
facts.sentence: Airement requires substantial supervision to protect oneself or others.

facts.name: Functional Limitation Definition
facts.sentence: Substantial Activity means a functional limitation requiring assistance with three or more Activities of Daily Living.

facts.name: Death Benefit Payout
facts.sentence: The insurer will pay $3,000,000 to the named beneficiary upon receipt of satisfactory proof of the insured's death during the policy period.

facts.name: Proof of Death Requirement
facts.sentence: Satisfactory proof of the insured's death includes documentation that confirms the death occurred during the policy period.

facts.name: Premium Payment Requirement
facts.sentence: Payment under Section 1.1 is contingent upon all premiums having been paid.

facts.name: Claim Processing Timeline
facts.sentence: Claims are processed within thirty calendar days of receiving complete documentation.

facts.name: Claim Payment Delay Interest
facts.sentence: Interest at the current federal applicable rate accrues on any undisputed claim not paid within thirty days.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Clause
facts.sentence: Suicide within two years of the policy date excludes full benefits.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Clause
facts.sentence: If suicide occurs within two years of the policy date, the benefit is limited to a return of premiums paid without interest.

facts.name: Aviation Exclusion: Experimental Aircraft Crew
facts.sentence: Death while operating or training as crew in any experimental aircraft is excluded.

facts.name: Military Aircraft Operation Exclusion
facts.sentence: Death while operating or training as crew in any military aircraft is excluded.

facts.name: Aviation Exclusion: Ultralight Crew
facts.sentence: Death while operating or training as crew in any ultralight aircraft is excluded.

facts.name: Commercial Aircraft Coverage
facts.sentence: Passenger travel in commercial certified aircraft is fully covered.

facts.name: Private Aircraft Coverage
facts.sentence: Passenger travel in private certificated aircraft is fully covered.

facts.name: Voluntary Combat Exclusion
facts.sentence: Voluntary participation in armed combat results in exclusion of benefits.

facts.name: Insurrection Exclusion
facts.sentence: Insurrection leads to exclusion of benefits when causing death.

facts.name: Non-Combatant War Zone Coverage
facts.sentence: Death occurring in a war zone in a non-combatant capacity is covered.

facts.name: Accelerated Benefit Inclusion
facts.sentence: Rider 1: Accelerated Death Benefit – Terminal Condition is included at no additional charge.

facts.name: Accelerated Benefit Eligibility
facts.sentence: Up to eighty percent of the face amount may be advanced under Rider 1 upon certification of a terminal condition.

facts.name: Maximum Advance Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum advance available under Rider 1 is $2,400,000.

facts.name: Minimum Advance Amount
facts.sentence: The minimum advance amount under Rider 1 is $50,000.

facts.name: Actuarial Discount Application
facts.sentence: An actuarial discount applies to advances made under Rider 1.

facts.name: Terminal Condition Acceleration
facts.sentence: Up to 80% of the face amount can be accelerated upon certification of Terminal Condition.

facts.name: Terminal Condition Acceleration Cap
facts.sentence: The maximum acceleration under the Terminal Condition rider is $2,400,000.

facts.name: Minimum Advance Threshold
facts.sentence: The minimum advance available under the Terminal Condition rider is $50,000.

facts.name: Actuarial Discount Application
facts.sentence: An actuarial discount rate of 7% per year is applied to the expected benefit period.

facts.name: Trusted Oversight Requirement
facts.sentence: Trustee authorization is required in addition to insured consent for benefits to be accessed.

facts.name: Remaining Death Benefit to Trust
facts.sentence: The remaining death benefit is paid to the trust upon the insured's death.

facts.name: Terminal Condition Trigger
facts.sentence: The trigger for accessing benefits under the Terminal Condition rider is life expectancy ≤ 18 months.

facts.name: More Generous Terminal Condition Criteria
facts.sentence: The Terminal Condition trigger is more generous than standard criteria.

facts.name: Annual Premium for Rider 2
facts.sentence: The annual premium for Rider 2: Accelerated Death Benefit – Chronic/Cognitive Decline is $1,800.

facts.name: Monthly Access Limit under Cognitive Impairment
facts.sentence: Under Rider 2, up to 3% of the face amount may be accessed per month upon qualifying Cognitive Impairment.

facts.name: Monthly Access Limit – Chronic Decline
facts.sentence: Under Rider 2, up to 3% of the face amount may be accessed per month upon substantial activity limitation.

facts.name: Annual Maximum Benefit Limit
facts.sentence: The annual maximum benefit under Rider 2 is 24% of the face amount.

facts.name: Annual Benefit Cap – Rider 2
facts.sentence: The annual maximum benefit under Rider 2 is capped at $720,000 per year.

facts.name: Lifetime Benefit Cap – Rider 2
facts.sentence: The lifetime maximum benefit under Rider 2 is 60% of the face amount.

facts.name: Lifetime Benefit Cap
facts.sentence: The lifetime maximum benefit under Rider 2 is capped at $1,800,000.

facts.name: Hospitalization Waiver
facts.sentence: There is no elimination period for claims under Rider 2 if the insured is hospitalized.

facts.name: 60-Day Elimination Period (Non-Hospitalized)
facts.sentence: A 60-day elimination period applies under Rider 2 if hospitalization did not occur.

facts.name: Geriatric Assessment Requirement
facts.sentence: An independent geriatric assessment is required at the time of claim submission for Rider 2.

facts.name: Benefit Coordination with LTC Insurance
facts.sentence: Monthly benefits under Rider 2 are coordinated with any long-term care (LTC) insurance in force.

facts.name: Charitable Giving Rider Premium
facts.sentence: The annual premium for Rider 3: Charitable Giving Rider is $800.

facts.name: Charity Election Window
facts.sentence: Upon the insured's death, the policy owner (acting as trustee) may elect within 90 days to redirect part of the death benefit.

facts.name: Charitable Redirection Window
facts.sentence: The election window for charitable redirection is 90 days after receipt of the death benefit.

facts.name: Charitable Redirect Limit
facts.sentence: Up to 10% of the net death benefit may be redirected under the Charitable Giving Rider.

facts.name: Charitable Redirect Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum amount that may be redirected under the Charitable Giving Rider is $100,000.

facts.name: Charitable Redirect Eligibility
facts.sentence: Redirected funds may go to one or more qualified 501(c)(3) organizations.

facts.name: Charity Designation Requirement
facts.sentence: The designation of charities must be specified in the trust instrument.

facts.name: Irrevocable Charity Election
facts.sentence: Once made, the election to redirect funds is irrevocable.

facts.name: Charitable Redirection Tax Treatment
facts.sentence: Charitable redirection does not reduce the taxable death benefit for estate tax purposes.

facts.name: Estate Tax Deduction via Charity
facts.sentence: Charitable redirection may generate an estate tax charitable deduction.

facts.name: Annual Premium Amount
facts.sentence: The annual premium is $46,400.00.

facts.name: Annual Premium Due Date
facts.sentence: The due date for the annual premium is October 7 of each year.

facts.name: Payment Methods for Annual Premium
facts.sentence: The payment mode for the annual premium is either wire transfer or ACH from the trust account.

facts.name: Premium Notice Delivery
facts.sentence: A premium notice will be sent to the Trustee at the address of record.

facts.name: Premium Notice Timing
facts.sentence: The premium notice is sent 60 days in advance of the due date.

facts.name: Crummey Notice Timing
facts.sentence: The purpose of sending the premium notice early is to allow Crummey notices to be issued to trust beneficiaries.

facts.name: Grace Period Duration
facts.sentence: There is a grace period of 62 days.

facts.name: Grace Period Extension
facts.sentence: The grace period is extended for estate planning policies.

facts.name: Extended Grace Period Purpose
facts.sentence: The extension of the grace period allows time for trust administration procedures to be followed.

facts.name: Grace Period Death Benefit Deduction
facts.sentence: If death occurs during the grace period, the unpaid premium is deducted from the death benefit.

facts.name: One-Time Premium Deferral
facts.sentence: The owner may request a one-time premium deferral of up to 90 additional days in any policy year.

facts.name: Premium Deferral Approval
facts.sentence: Premium deferral is subject to approval.

facts.name: Premium Deferral Fee Requirement
facts.sentence: A deferral fee of $500 is required for premium deferral.

facts.name: No Consecutive Deferrals
facts.sentence: Premium deferral is not available in consecutive years.

facts.name: Trustee Conversion Privilege
facts.sentence: The trustee may convert all or part of this policy to permanent life insurance without evidence of insurability.

facts.name: Conversion Timing Window
facts.sentence: Conversion can occur before the earlier of the policy's 15th anniversary or the insured's 80th birthday.

facts.name: Minimum Conversion Amount
facts.sentence: The minimum conversion amount is $500,000.

facts.name: Age Impact on Conversion Premiums
facts.sentence: The insured's advanced age at conversion will affect the premiums for the resulting permanent policy.

facts.name: Conversion Product Availability
facts.sentence: Meridian Legacy's current whole life products are available for conversion.

facts.name: Conversion Product Availability
facts.sentence: Meridian Legacy's current survivorship products are available for conversion.

facts.name: Conversion Product Availability
facts.sentence: Meridian Legacy's current universal life products are available for conversion.

facts.name: Riders Terminate Upon Conversion
facts.sentence: All riders terminate upon conversion.

facts.name: Rider Continuity After Conversion
facts.sentence: Riders may only continue if they are re-elected and approved on the new permanent policy.

facts.name: Named Trustee Recognition
facts.sentence: The company recognizes only the named trustee(s) for all policy transactions.

facts.name: Trustee Change Procedure
facts.sentence: Changes of trustee require written notice with a certified copy of the trust amendment.

facts.name: Trustee Succession Escrow Protocol
facts.sentence: If the named trustee and all successors are unable or unwilling to serve, the company will hold all benefits in escrow.

facts.name: Court Appointment of Successor Trustee
facts.sentence: A successor trustee will be appointed by a court of competent jurisdiction when the named trustee and all successors are unable or unwilling to serve.

facts.name: Trustee Oversight Limitation
facts.sentence: The company is not responsible for verifying that the trustee is acting within the scope of the trust instrument.

facts.name: Incontestability After Two Years
facts.sentence: After this policy has been in force for 2 years during the insured's lifetime, the company will not contest the validity of this policy.

facts.name: Incontestability Exception
facts.sentence: The exception to the incontestability clause is non-payment of premiums.

facts.name: Governing Law Jurisdiction
facts.sentence: This policy is issued and governed under the laws of the State of Connecticut.

facts.name: Dispute Resolution Venue
facts.sentence: Any disputes regarding this policy shall be resolved in Hartford County Superior Court.

facts.name: Policy Issuance Location
facts.sentence: This policy was issued in Hartford, Connecticut.

facts.name: Signing Authority Role
